blind.description: A stylized wooden potter's wheel station. It features a four-legged timber and bamboo frame with a raised wooden bench plank on one side. In the center, a vertical axle connects a heavy grey stone flywheel at the base to an upper wooden wheelhead holding an unglazed grey clay pot. A small wooden side shelf attached to the top rails holds a shallow terracotta bowl with water/slip and a small grey smoothing stone. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A square timber frame enclosing a central round potter's wheel with a grey pot, a wide wooden seat plank along the top side, a lower grey circular flywheel underneath, and a small rectangular shelf along the right side holding a round terracotta bowl and a small grey rock.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
